A Tale of Lílí Read and the Madness of the Enamored

O Lílí Read, why dost thou read tales and fall into madness? Verily, the heart that is filled with the love of the Beloved is not given to idle stories and fanciful dreams. Rather, it is consumed with the yearning for union with Him Whose beauty is beyond all description.
